title: Vinyasa Before the Music
blurb: Morning flow in the Lucky Barn. Stretch out last night, get loose for tonight.

title: Rise & Shine Yoga
blurb: A morning class at the Courtyard, built for sore dancing legs and stiff camping backs.

title: Massage in the Woods
blurb: A cedar shower first, then a massage under the trees. Your dancing body, ready for one more night.

title: Family Yoga
blurb: Kids and parents on the mat together in the woods, easy and gentle, before the Coyote Stage starts.

title: Hike Scouters Mountain
blurb: Three and a half hilly miles into the nature park with a local guide, leaving on time.

title: Four Miles of Forest
blurb: Trails from the creek up toward Scouters Mountain. Slip away between sets and follow the music back.

title: Summer Camp for Your Kids
blurb: At Coyote, kids get a festival of their own: a stage, forts in the woods and a Sunday puppet parade.

title: Forest Floor Dance Party
blurb: The last band ends and the Woods keeps going. Dance under the firs long after dark.

title: Dance Around the Lilies
blurb: An open-air dance floor beside the barn, circled by two giant wooden water lilies.

title: Afternoon on the Hill
blurb: Records spin on the hillside in the shade of the firs. Lie back and let the afternoon go.

title: Records at the Crossroads
blurb: Every path crosses at the Market, and friends find each other. Stay for one song, stay for ten.

title: Dinner at a Hidden Table
blurb: A chef and an artist make the meal together beside the creek, and a band plays between courses.

title: Northwest Kitchens
blurb: Food trucks and kitchens from around the Northwest at the Market, plus a farmers market of fresh fruit.

title: Lunch Under the Firs
blurb: Eat on the shady hillside, close enough to hear the Windmill Stage while you do.

title: A Bite Between Shows
blurb: Grab a bite on the main path by the Lucky Barn and you won't miss a note.

title: The Bar in the Trees
blurb: A bar glowing in the forest after dark, steps from the Woods Stage, ready for the next round.

title: Coffee, Then Cocktails
blurb: The Brew Crew pours your first coffee on the hillside. By evening the Windmill Bar takes over.

title: Poured for the Menu
blurb: Wine, cider and cocktails picked to go with the chef's menu at every Curation meal.

title: A Cold One in the Shade
blurb: A bar under the Douglas firs at the Grove. Order a cold one and take your time between sets.

title: The Galaxy Bar
blurb: Steps from the dance floor, so the next round never pulls you away from the music.

title: The Market Bar
blurb: The bar at the Market, where every path crosses. Meet here, and plans get made.

title: Earn Your View
blurb: Wild Camp climbs to the top of the farm: big trees, a hillside of tents, a short walk down.

title: Wake Up Under Ferns
blurb: Giant ferns and leafy shade at Lush Camp. Your morning starts under a green canopy, not in a hot tent.

title: Sleep in Your Rig
blurb: Car, van and RV camping at Willow Camp. Park once, then walk to the music.

title: Van Camp by the Gate
blurb: Car, van and RV camping in the South Lot, with the shuttle and ticketing right there.

title: Comics in a Barn
blurb: Touring comedians in the Lucky Barn, two nights of ninety minutes each. Small enough to heckle back.

title: Sunday Stories in the Woods
blurb: Storytelling and spoken word on the Woods Stage Sunday morning, coffee in hand, nowhere to be.

title: Authors on the Hill
blurb: Writers read from their work on the Windmill hillside Sunday morning. Bring nothing but time.

title: Murals Painted Live
blurb: Watch artists paint a wall over the weekend, then pick up a brush in the workshop.

title: The Grotto Gallery
blurb: A small gallery tucked just up the trail from the Market. Worth the detour.

title: Craft Row
blurb: Makers and artists selling what they made by hand. Meet the person who made it.

title: Merry Pop In Shop
blurb: Secondhand treasures and repurposed finds. Something for your camp, something to take home, nothing too serious.

title: Archery and Adventure Games
blurb: Bows, targets and field games in the woods, with room for kids to run until they are tired.

title: Wilderness Survival School
blurb: A school in the woods where kids learn how to look after themselves outdoors.

title: Make Something by Hand
blurb: Kids make something with their own hands at Coyote and carry it back to camp.

title: Ukulele and Talent Show
blurb: Strum a ukulele, then take the stage at the kids' talent show with the whole farm cheering.

title: Family Jam
blurb: Families make music together at Coyote, with room for every age and every kind of noise.

title: Sunday Storytime
blurb: Settle in on Sunday morning for stories read aloud at Coyote, the gentlest start to the day.

title: A Quiet Nest for Babies
blurb: A calm spot at Coyote for babies and their parents to rest between songs.

title: Sound Bath
blurb: Lie back and let sound wash over you, a slow reset between loud nights.

title: Cedar Showers
blurb: Rinse off the dust in a cedar shower, then walk back to the music feeling new.

title: Tea Ceremony
blurb: Slow down with a cup of tea and a little ceremony, a quiet pause in a loud weekend.

title: Tarot and Readings
blurb: Sit for a reading and see what the cards, or the reader, have to say about your weekend.

title: Poetry on a Typewriter
blurb: Poetry made on a typewriter, a small, slow thing to carry home from a big weekend.

title: Morning Coffee on the Hill
blurb: The Brew Crew pours coffee on the hillside, a slow start before the first set.

title: Evenings at the Windmill Bar
blurb: When the sun drops, the Windmill Bar takes over the hillside, with the stage a few steps away.

title: Quiet Sets in the Barn
blurb: The Lucky Barn hushes for the quiet sets, close enough to hear every word.

title: Sunday Brunch at Curation
blurb: On Sunday morning the chef and artist set another table, this time for brunch.
